archetypes.name: dyn-bgwait-marker
archetypes.rationale: Inspect marker field parity and keepalive fallback behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 marker update and the new writer-parity lint for clone ownership correctness. Check that missing or symlinked keepalive files fail open with an empty CLONE_PATH field, and that each inventoried writer is validated without accidentally treating cleanup-only references as writers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
